Title: Some users’ Microsoft 365 Copilot chats created in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word may display as an untitled chat

User impact: Users’ Copilot chats created in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word may display as an untitled chat.

More info: Aside from being untitled, the impacted chats operate as expected.

Current status: We’re investigating a potential issue preventing Copilot chat titles from being generated when chats are created in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. We’ll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users’ Microsoft 365 Copilot chats created in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word may display as an untitled chat

User impact: Users’ Copilot chats created in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word may display as an untitled chat.

More info: Aside from being untitled, the impacted chats operate as expected.

Current status: We’re reviewing system logs to isolate the origin of this issue.

Next update by: Tuesday, July 28, 2026, at 5:00 AM UTC

Title: Some users’ Microsoft 365 Copilot chats created in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word may display as an untitled chat

User impact: Users’ Copilot chats created in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word may display as an untitled chat.

More info: Aside from being untitled, the impacted chats operate as expected.

Current status: We’re continuing to review system logs while attempting to reproduce the issue internally to gain further insight into the potentially-impacted scenario and determine our next steps.

Scope of impact: Some users leveraging Copilot chat through Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, and Microsoft Word may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues. 

Next update by: Tuesday, July 28, 2026, at 7:00 AM UTC

Title: Some users’ Microsoft 365 Copilot chats created in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word may display as an untitled chat

User impact: Users’ Copilot chats created in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word may display as an untitled chat.

More info: Aside from being untitled, the impacted chats operate as expected.

Current status: We suspect that a recently enabled conversation update process is overwriting some chat titles with an empty value. We’re comparing successful and affected requests to determine what triggers the behavior and identify the appropriate fix.

Scope of impact: Some users leveraging Copilot chat through Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, and Microsoft Word may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues. 

Next update by: Tuesday, July 28, 2026, at 12:00 PM UTC
